question: How does fixed IL1B-CLDN4 RNA association across adjacent QC tissue spots vary by lattice scale and patient-matched histology in the public Visium sections?
decision: Determine whether the public sections provide spatial RNA organization beyond old whole-section means, and quantify dependence on depth, broad RNA composition and edges without substituting pathology labels.
strongest_rival: Autocorrelated RNA fields, mixed spots, library depth, broad composition and irregular tissue geometry can yield cross-spot association without cell contact or IL-1 signaling.
discriminator: Same-spot, one-hop and exactly two-hop standardized cross-products; within-component depth adjustment and fixed broad RNA composition/interior sensitivities, with patient-level histology contrasts.
exposure_record: Old whole-section means and prior measured maps are exposed, as are A12 results. New graph statistics have not been calculated. Cache file names, sizes, headers, two QC coordinate rows and original QC rules were inspected; complete source bytes were hashed before freeze.
biological_unit: Patient; 25 source patient labels with 56 nested Visium sections in the same Peng/C3 source lineage.
nesting_and_overlap: Spots nested within components and sections, repeated sections nested within patients. Same patients overlap snRNA source; this is not external validation. No source specimen or serial-section equivalence is inferred.
population_and_selection: All56 GSE307534 sections; original tissue mask and >=500 counts, >=200 detected genes, <=15% mitochondrial QC. Retain graph components >=20 spots and sections >=100 retained spots; report smaller supports without threshold rescue.
contrast: Primary within-patient LUAD-minus-AAH, repeated sections averaged equally; AIS and MIA contrasts and spot-weighted section aggregation are prespecified secondary descriptions.
endpoint: Primary IL1B-CLDN4 symmetric one-hop mean standardized residual cross-product on the Visium lattice. Same-spot, two-hop, lag contrast, individual Moran-style and interior endpoints retained.
methods: Recompute full matrix QC and five fixed normalized genes, verify both coordinate files and cached values. Six lattice offsets, no gap bridging. Component-specific depth regression, pooled residual RMS; scalar independent neighbor-list verification. Exact choices in PUBLIC_SPATIAL_SPEC_V1.md.
missingness_and_exclusions: No unmeasured-to-zero imputation. Hash/source/coordinate/QC disagreement stops. Insufficient graph support or zero residual variance produces missing endpoints, no altered genes or floors. No pathology score-based region substitution.
multiplicity: One fixed transcript pair, three transforms and stated distance/edge diagnostics; all patient matches and signs reported. No significance testing, spot shuffle, score search or new predictor.
precision_basis: Patient-level deltas, empirical range and leave-one-patient-out mean range. This is finite exposed description without spot-based p values, a null distribution, power margin or equivalence claim.
interpretation_limit: Spatial RNA organization in mixed spots only; no named cell state/pathology region, macrophage attribution, physical radius, contact, direction, causal reception, identical serial-section cells or 80-micrometer Xenium reproduction.
stop_rule: Stop for source hash, duplicate/absent target, count, barcode, coordinate or cached QC/value disagreement. Narrow numerical support failures remain explicit missingness; do not block completed independent A12 work.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized public spot-level branch adds bounded lattice description to Pg1-P01/C3 while original author-dependent reproduction and A12 spatial stages remain held.
